snippet.title: Samhain - Halloween Horror Game
snippet.description:
Samhain (2019) - It's your favorite holiday. Take your brothers out trick-or-treating but stay on the trail. And don't talk to strangers!

Cure your post-Halloween blues with some spooky fun. Soundtrack by KC Mxxn Luna and Clément Pandemonium

Get it: http://patreon.com/puppetcombo
